question.prompt: At the same time, a vertically placed bamboo pole \(2\text{ m}\) long casts a shadow \(1.5\text{ m}\) long, and a tree casts a shadow \(6\text{ m}\) long. Find the height of the tree. (Unit: m)

solutions.explanation: The ratio of object height to shadow length is the same: \(2/1.5=h/6\), giving \(h=8\).
solutions.title: Equal height-to-shadow ratios
